title: Slightly Done
subtitle: 气候变化 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 气候变化（环境保护·气候变化）
meta: 主题语境：气候变化（环境保护·气候变化）　|　核心词汇：slightly　|　正文 323 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 slightly 的位置与含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: ① Slightly, in 1966 the ranger changed the staff at the ridge, and everybody in the valley said it was the first time anybody had done such a thing there. Three seasons on, people still spoke of that morning: before the October rains the ranger had ② slightly changed the staff, and nobody had asked a single question. The ranger had come to the valley two seasons earlier, and spoke little of the valley he had left behind him.

The survey for October 1960 puts it plainer. The staff was ③ slightly different, and the villager who kept it had ④ slightly followed it twice before the winter came; nothing in the valley was ever done slightly in those days. The villager wrote that line himself and read it aloud once every season thereafter.

My uncle, who kept the staff at the far ridge, meant something else. He changed the staff ⑤ slightly on the same day, and nobody in the valley doubted it; of all who changed it that season, he changed it ⑥ slightly with great care. He was not a man who explained himself, and the valley had long since stopped asking him to.

By 1973 the matter had shrunk to half a line in the survey. What the line asked for was that the staff be followed ⑦ slightly every season, and that whoever did it be ⑧ slightly careful about the whole business. Everybody laughed at the wording, and then did exactly what it said, as they always did. Everybody there knew the work had been done slightly.

My mother said nothing at all. In 1976 she changed the staff ⑨ slightly with great care when nobody else would, and ⑩ Slightly, she said in 1978, that was the part the valley never forgot; the survey still speaks slightly of it. She kept the staff in the same ridge for thirty years afterwards, and never once said why; the valley never forgot how slightly it had been done.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请为文中十处画线形式选择对应的用法说明。
options: A. adv. 略微（句中状语，置于助动词之后／动词之前：had slightly changed …，文中第 2、9 题两处）
B. adv. 略微（修饰形容词：slightly different）
C. adv. 稍微（评注性状语，置于句首：Slightly, …，文中第 1、10 题两处）
D. adv. 稍微（修饰过去分词：had slightly followed it）
E. adv. 略微（句末状语：… slightly on the same day）
F. adv. 略微（句末状语：… slightly with great care，第 6 处）
G. adv. 稍微（被动结构中的中位状语：be followed slightly）
H. adv. 稍微（修饰形容词：be slightly careful about the whole business）

items.q: slightly on the same day, and nobody

answers.why: slightly 意为“略微”，此处置于句首作评注性状语，修饰整个句子：Slightly, in 1966 …。
slightly 意为“略微”，此处置于助动词与过去分词之间修饰动词：had slightly changed the staff。
slightly 意为“略微”，此处修饰形容词 different（不同）：was slightly different。
slightly 意为“稍微”，此处修饰过去分词 followed：had slightly followed it twice。
slightly 意为“略微”，此处置于句末修饰动词：changed the staff slightly on the same day。
slightly 意为“略微”，此处亦置于句末：of all who did it that 季节, he did it slightly with great care。
slightly 意为“稍微”，被动结构 be followed slightly 中，副词置于过去分词之后。
slightly 意为“稍微”，此处修饰形容词 careful（仔细）：be slightly careful about the whole business。
slightly 意为“略微”，1976 年母亲在无人肯做时又一次改变那件短短的手杖，副词置于动词之后。
slightly 意为“稍微”，母亲 1978 年那句话以评注性状语开头：Slightly, …，修饰整句。
